notes.title: USP Feature: Journaling!
notes.notes:
Hi, friends and fans of Helen!

We’re excited to announce the addition of a brand-new feature to Helen: Journaling. This feature allows you to express your creativity and reflect on Helen’s journey in a deeply personal way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/396e4cd12681d17a2d97008adc3a86f1d66a7498.png[/img]

[b]What Makes This Feature Unique?[/b]

Journaling in Helen is more than just a gameplay mechanic. It’s a way for you to connect with the story on a whole new level. You’ll have the freedom to choose from a variety of beautifully illustrated scenes, decorate them with frames and stickers, and arrange them in a digital journal however you like. This feature mimics the experience of real-life journaling, giving you full control to personalize and create something uniquely yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/3b4bb6c0bd878b3b6f63b8310dc0b91beb2f3436.png[/img]

We believe this mechanic adds an authentic and immersive layer to the game, making Helen’s story feel even more relatable and meaningful. Whether you’re capturing her moments of triumph, reflection, or connection, the journal becomes a canvas for your creativity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/75f5e47fdbbf77261387b8b24028e434e59f58fe.png[/img]

[b]Why This Update Matters[/b]

The journaling feature represents our commitment to delivering a heartfelt and immersive experience. By offering a space to reflect and decorate Helen’s journey, we aim to:

[list]
Celebrate Personalization: Players have the freedom to decorate and arrange them in the journal however they like.

Enhance Storytelling: The journal serves as a visual and interactive way to engage with Helen’s narrative, making every moment more impactful.

Encourage Creativity: With flexible design options, the journal lets players showcase their artistic side and create something truly unique.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/80154268309ed0be0059690dff2944cee9d84efa.png[/img]

We’re excited to hear your thoughts about the journaling feature! Drop your comments below and let us know what you think. We’ll keep you updated with more news and improvements as we continue to enhance the Helen experience.

Thank you for being part of Helen’s journey. Stay tuned for more exciting news!

Cheers,
Eternal Dream Studio

notes.title: Helen Game Update: Delicious Food Art is Here!
notes.notes:
Hi, friends and fans of Helen!

We’ve got some tasty news to share with you about one of the most exciting parts of Helen: the food! Indonesia’s amazing dishes play a big role in the game, and we’ve been working hard to make them look as good as they taste in real life. Here’s a closer look at what we’ve been cooking up:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/ab6b1e7e36086cbec9508e6d296db1f34396237f.png[/img]

1. Nasi Goreng

Our nasi goreng (fried rice) is looking better than ever! The rice has a beautiful golden-brown color, and you can see every grain. It’s topped with fresh cucumber & tomato slices and a sunny-side-up egg. It’s colorful, delicious, and definitely eye-catching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/81ffca87650db0603f1935ef948285d3df656dab.png[/img]

2. Satay Ayam

You can almost smell the smoky goodness of our satay ayam (chicken skewers). The chicken looks perfectly grilled with caramelized edges and is dripping with rich, creamy peanut sauce. It’s served with lontong (rice cakes) and a wedge of lime for the perfect finishing touch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/df619538106be035ed3041864f11a9a5634939de.png[/img]

3. Rawon Setan

Say hello to rawon setan (devil’s black soup), a dish full of bold flavors. The dark broth looks rich and aromatic, with tender chunks of beef. It’s topped with bean sprouts, a squeeze of lime, and a dollop of spicy sambal for an extra kick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/1940b0419d75d2ee06f80412dc52c29479c94969.png[/img]

4. Mie Ayam

Who doesn’t love mie ayam (chicken noodle soup)? Our version features golden noodles in a tasty broth, topped with juicy chicken, fresh greens, and crispy fried shallots. It’s the ultimate comfort food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/8b49b98a719b4d84cfb9b101d8294cc1b6cc2cfd.png[/img]

5. Kue Tradisional

Our kue tradisional (traditional cakes) are a feast for the eyes! From the colorful layers of lapis legit to the soft, sweet klepon filled with melted palm sugar, these treats are as beautiful as they are delicious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697937/b784cad3d0124c7d68622b2677a8fb44c687ea02.png[/img]

6. Soto

Finally, we have soto (Indonesian soup). The golden broth is packed with shredded chicken, boiled eggs, and vermicelli noodles. It’s topped with fried shallots and fresh celery leaves for that comforting, homemade feel.

Why This Update Matters

In Helen, food isn’t just part of the background; it tells a story. It connects Helen to her culture, her family, and her journey. By making these dishes look amazing, we hope to make the game even more immersive and celebrate Indonesia’s incredible food.

What’s Next?

We’re always working to make Helen even better, and we’d love to hear from you! Which dishes should we add next? Let us know your ideas and stay tuned for more updates.

Thanks for all your support! We can’t wait to share these delicious updates with you.

Cheers,
Eternal Dream Studio
